description: NFT metadata on Celo: the token URI of one ERC-721 token id (tokenURI) and the JSON it points to (name, description, image, attributes), read from data: URIs, https or ipfs:// (through ipfs.io). Strings over 1,000 characters, such as on-chain SVG images, are shortened. Use to show or check what an NFT is; for its owner use celo_nft_owner. A token that does not exist is 422, uncharged; unreachable metadata is reported in metadataError. Example: contract=0x3d79EdAaBC0EaB6F08ED885C05Fc0B014290D95A, tokenId=1. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: celo_nft_metadata
title: NFT metadata, Celo
